The article hinted that the FBI recieved a warrant to gather login information. If a server is compromised, it is possible to trick the client into identifying itself.

For instance, in the TOR browser JavaScript is enabled by default, so if an agent has access to the server, it would be trivial to add a script that tells the browser to "phone home" the real IP address of the client.

So, I doubt TOR itself is compromised. The problem is, more likely, that 1) The server was compromised, and 2) clients are not disabling javascript.
